segments.objective: Establish ExpenSense and the user's financial overview.
actions: Hold on the greeting, mascot insight, monthly total and category grid.
segments.visual_focus: Greeting, mascot, monthly total and budget progress.
segments.caption: Know where your money goes.
segments.voiceover: ExpenSense brings everyday spending, budgets, and insights into one clear view.
segments.transition_in: 1-second wordmark dissolve over the live dashboard
segments.recording_notes: Use seeded current-month data and let entry/progress animations settle before the Scan tap.

segments.objective: Show the three supported ways to record an expense.
actions: pause on Scan Receipt, Upload Receipt and Manual Entry
segments.visual_focus: The three action rows, especially Scan Receipt.
segments.caption: Add expenses your way.
segments.voiceover: Add an expense manually, upload a photo, or scan the receipt in the moment.
segments.recording_notes: Preserve the full device so the central Scan tab remains spatially clear.

segments.visual_focus: Receipt inside the mint scan frame and capture control.
segments.caption: Capture the whole receipt.
segments.voiceover: Frame the full receipt, then capture it with one tap.
segments.transition_out: match cut from receipt to processing mascot
segments.recording_notes: Permission must already be granted. Use a physical printed receipt; screenshot-like inputs are rejected by implementation.

segments.objective: Communicate the real recognition pipeline without lingering on network time.
actions: Show steps changing from active to complete
segments.visual_focus: Reading receipt title, mascot and step checklist.
segments.caption: From photo to structured details.
segments.voiceover: ExpenSense checks image quality, reads the receipt, and verifies its structure and totals.
segments.transition_out: clean cut once navigation reaches review
segments.recording_notes: Record the full wait separately; speed-ramp or trim pauses, but keep step order intact. Do not fabricate a success state.

segments.objective: Show reviewability, data confidence, and exact financial consequences before saving.
actions: Pause on receipt thumbnail and Ready/Needs Review state
scroll through merchant, items, totals and wallet
segments.visual_focus: Detected fields, item totals, category, wallet, and before/after preview.
segments.caption: Review before it counts.
segments.voiceover: Before anything is saved, review the merchant, items, category, wallet, and totals—and see exactly what will change.
segments.transition_out: UI-driven save followed by route replacement
segments.recording_notes: Return to 100% scale before the save tap. Correct OCR mistakes before recording or make one deliberate correction on camera.

segments.objective: Prove the result was saved as a verified ledger entry.
actions: Hold on the Coffee Project PHP 372.00 row and success toast
optionally tap the row for a 1-second verified chip insert
segments.visual_focus: Newest Coffee Project row and amount.
segments.caption: Saved, categorized, traceable.
segments.voiceover: The purchase becomes a categorized transaction in the ledger, with its receipt source preserved.
segments.transition_out: bottom-tab tap or horizontal panel swipe
segments.recording_notes: Ensure sorting is Newest and filters are clear before the take.

segments.objective: Show the expense's effect on money and budget context.
actions: hold on total balance and Food budget row
segments.visual_focus: Daily Wallet balance and Food budget progress.
segments.caption: Balances stay in sync.
segments.voiceover: Its wallet balance and category budget update from the same confirmed record.
segments.recording_notes: Balances must be visible; do not toggle privacy mode.

segments.objective: Turn the saved record into financial understanding.
actions: hold on Top Category and Recurring Expenses
segments.visual_focus: Category donut, Food share, recurring Coffee Project insight.
segments.caption: See patterns, not just totals.
segments.voiceover: Analytics reveal where spending is concentrated, while insights surface recurring merchants and budget pressure.
segments.recording_notes: Use the seeded records so Food is top and Coffee Project appears twice.

segments.objective: Close on the updated product overview and brand.
segments.visual_focus: Updated monthly total, mascot insight and ExpenSense wordmark.
segments.caption: Track smarter. Live better.
segments.voiceover: So every receipt becomes a clearer picture of your finances.
segments.recording_notes: Use the real wordmark asset; no additional product claim.
